samples: This module loads a service configuration from JSON, validates that the port, worker count, and log level all fit the declared constraints, and reports either file-read problems or shape/validation problems. It also provides a built-in default configuration, plus two convenience wrappers that fall back to defaults or to a caller-supplied configuration when loading fails. The older fallback helper is marked deprecated, so new users should prefer the more flexible replacement.

This module loads a service configuration from a JSON file, validates that the port, worker count, and log level fit the declared constraints, and reports either file-read problems or shape/validation problems. It also provides a built-in default configuration and two fallback helpers: one that falls back to the default, and one that falls back to a caller-supplied configuration. If you want strict config validation with simple recovery paths, it’s useful; if you need richer error detail or more flexible parsing, it may be too minimal.
